beats.display_text: Idea four is the mental model. A draft isn't one line of text. It's a tree of possibilities, and you decide when each branch closes. Or whether it ever does.
That gives you three habits. When you're torn between two phrasings, don't choose yet. Add a variant.
When you're unsure a line belongs, ghost it instead of deleting it.
And when you love a line that doesn't fit, send it to Overflow.

Your first minute: a welcome card and a short tour walk you through each move once. Ctrl+Shift+R hides the tools when you want just your words. The question-mark button brings the card, and this video, back.
Then write the way you always do. Reach for these tools only at the moment you feel the urge to delete.
